result:
I graded submission s2 for quiz 0001 and wrote the grades to `grades/0001-s2.json`. You got 3 correct, 2 partial and 1 wrong.

| Item | Verdict | Feedback |
|---|---|---|
| q1 | Correct | The loop is what makes a system an agent. |
| q2 | Correct | The model only writes a request that names the tool and its arguments. |
| q3 | Wrong | You chose "left to run longer, it will eventually fix the bug". An agent that repeats the same failure 40 times needs a step limit that stops the loop. Extra loops also cost you model calls. |
| q4 | Partial | 4 is right, but the model doesn't run the tools. The program runs them, and the 4 calls are the question plus three tool results. |
| q5 | Correct | You gave both what happens (the result goes back in as the next input) and why (so the model can decide its next step). |
| q6 | Partial | The name is part of how the model chooses, but it relies on the whole description: name, purpose and parameters. This is why tool descriptions matter for your design. |

**What to work on:** the program runs the tools, not the model, and every loop needs a stopping condition.

**Next step:** write out the text the model would see for `check_calendar` (name, one-line description, parameters). Then explain how it would choose between that tool and `search_manuals`.

I also added learning record `0003` and updated `NOTES.md` with these gaps. `s1` is still ungraded.
